column1: # FT-710 DISPLAY: T24 round 8 names (also appended to names_display.tsv)

column3: [fact] (on, handle): on = 1 tail-calls slot 0 of the SDHI operation table (the clock by mode) with the signed halfword +0x2C4, else slot 1 (clock stop) and 0; Ghidra FUN_2013c928 (T24 round 8, drivers/sd_setup.c)

[fact] CMD11 (three tries), R1 error bits 0x2C80008 (-23), clock off, slots 4/14/5 (host level 2 then 3), clock on; called by sd_card_identify when flags +0x2C0 bit 2 (S18A) is set; Ghidra FUN_2013cde8 (T24 round 8)
[fact] CMD3: RCA from R6 into +0x2AA (SD), RCA 1 for an MMC; tail call of sd_card_identify; new entry (T24 round 8)
[fact] CID bytes 0..2 and 3..14 not all zero, else -5; tail call of sd_read_csd_cid; new entry (T24 round 8)
[fact] CMD6 group 1 function 1 (0x00FFFFF1, switch 0x80FFFFF1), slot 12 (1), clock mode +0x2C4 = 2; tail call of sd_select_bus_speed; new entry (T24 round 8)

[fact] CMD6 group 1 functions SDR104/DDR50/SDR50/high speed with the current limit (0xFF3FF2..4), stepping down when slot 7 refuses or above 800 mA; speed +0x2C2 and clock mode +0x2C4 by function; tail call of sd_select_bus_speed; new entry (T24 round 8)
[fact] CMD6 group 3 (driver strength) function 0: inquiry 0x00FFF0FF, switch 0x80FFF0FF, gated by the support bit +0x272 and slot 6; was sd_switch_status_check (T24 round 8)
[fact] slot 2 (card check) of the handle's operation table; driver op 9; new entry (T24 round 8)
[fact] driver op 7: power on, identify, CSD/CID, select, bus width, speed, SD status, clock, sd_mount_volume, flags +0x68 bits 7 and 5 under itron_loc_cpu; new entry (T24 round 8, drivers/sd_drive.c)
[fact] driver op 8: slot 10, then +0x68 &= 0x7F under the CPU lock; new entry (T24 round 8)
[fact] driver op 5: slot 25 (open), sd_card_task_start, the handle into the drive +0x24; new entry (T24 round 8)
[fact] zeroes 32 sectors (FAT12/16) or one cluster (FAT32) after the FATs with progress; tail call of fat_format_volume 0x2013F834; new entry (T24 round 8, app/fat_format.c)
[fact] parameters cleared, fat_format_layout, the MBR, boot sector, FSInfo (FAT32) and FATs, then the tail call of fat_format_clear_root; the whole volume format; was fat_clear_root_dir (T24 round 8)
[fact] (index): bit 5 of +0x68 of the drive 0x20808B60[index], 0 without a handle; called from 0x20103BC4; new entry (T24 round 8)
